The home mountain of the Greek Gods is Mount Olympus.

To understand how search engines work, imagine the Internet as a massive, endless library. In this analogy, each website is like a specific book, and every individual web page is a single page within that book. Just as a library index or catalog helps you locate the exact book and page you need, a search engine like Google acts as that index, helping you find the precise website and page that contains the information you are looking for.
